acm.blocker: ACM policy requires policy-compliant manual execution through an authorized interface.

ieee.blocker: The prior inactive credential was exposed in local diagnostic output and must be rotated and activated before any request.

scopus.blocker: No Elsevier API key or required institutional token is configured.

interpretation_boundary: Prepared plans, web-surrogate candidate discovery, and replacement evidence do not establish completed publisher- and index-native coverage. Stable v1 requires completed ACM and IEEE execution plus either completed Scopus execution or an accepted, explicitly non-equivalent Scopus exclusion after DBLP author screening.
